units.source_text: 她的父母也认为她的顾虑确有道理，亦惟有互相悲叹，一筹莫展。

en.t: Her parents also felt that her worries were indeed reasonable, and they could only lament together, utterly at a loss.

units.source_text: 明石道人忽然想起：他夫人的已故的祖父，叫作中务亲王的，在京郊嵯峨地方大堰河附近有一所宫邸。

en.t: The Akashi monk suddenly remembered that his late wife's grandfather, Prince Nakatsukasa, had once had a residence near the Oi River in Saga, on the outskirts of the capital.

units.source_text: 这亲王的后裔零落，没有一个继承人，因此这宫邸年来久已荒芜。

en.t: The prince's descendants had fallen into decline, and there was no heir, so the residence had long since fallen into ruin.

units.source_text: 有一个前代传下来的管家之类的人，现正代管着这领地。

en.t: A sort of steward handed down from earlier generations was currently managing the estate on their behalf.

units.source_text: 明石道人便叫这个人来，同他商谈：“我已看破红尘，决意长此隐居在乡下了。

en.t: The Akashi monk summoned this man and consulted with him, saying, "I have already turned away from the world and resolved to live hidden in the countryside from now on.

units.source_text: 岂知到了晚年，又逢到一件意外之事，想再在京中找求一所住宅。

en.t: But unexpectedly, in my later years, something unforeseen has come up, and I would like to look for a residence in the capital again.

units.source_text: 但倘立刻迁往繁华热闹之区，又觉不甚相宜。

en.t: Yet it does not seem very suitable to move at once into a bustling, fashionable district.

units.source_text: 因为住惯乡村的人，在那里心情不安。

en.t: For someone accustomed to country life would feel uneasy there.

units.source_text: 为此想起了你所管领的那所宫邸。

en.t: That is why I thought of the residence under your care.

units.source_text: 一切费用由我送上，如果修理下来还可住人，即请动工，不知可否？”

en.t: I will provide all the expenses; if it can be repaired enough to be lived in, would you please begin the work?"

units.source_text: 那人答道：“这座宅子多年无人管领，现已荒芜得像草原一般了。

en.t: The man replied, "That mansion has had no one to look after it for many years, and it is now as overgrown as a field.

units.source_text: 我把那几间旁屋略加修理，胡乱住在里头。

en.t: I have made a few rough repairs to some side buildings and am barely living there.

units.source_text: 今年春间，源氏内大臣老爷在那地方建造佛堂，附近一带便有许多人夫来来往往，十分嘈杂。

en.t: This spring, Lord Genji the Inner Minister began building a Buddhist hall in that area, so many laborers have been coming and going nearby, making it very noisy.

units.source_text: 这佛堂造得非常讲究，营造工人异常众多。

en.t: The hall is being built with great care, and there are an extraordinary number of craftsmen at work.

units.source_text: 倘欲找求清静之所，则我那地方甚不相宜。”

en.t: If you are looking for a quiet place, then my area is quite unsuitable."

units.source_text: 明石道人说：“这倒不妨。

en.t: The Akashi monk said, "That is no obstacle.

units.source_text: 不瞒你说，我们是与内大臣有缘，正欲托他荫庇的。

en.t: To tell you the truth, we have ties with the Inner Minister and are just hoping to rely on his protection.

units.source_text: 房屋内部的修饰，我们自会逐渐安排。

en.t: As for furnishing and decorating the inside of the house, we will arrange that gradually ourselves.

units.source_text: 首先只要赶快把房屋大体加以修缮。”

en.t: For now, it is enough if you quickly make the main repairs to the house."

units.source_text: 那人答道：“这不是我的产业，亲王家又没有继承人。

en.t: The man answered, "This is not my property, and the prince's family has no heir.

units.source_text: 我过惯了乡间闲静生涯，所以长年隐居在那里。

en.t: I am used to a quiet country life, so I have lived there in seclusion for many years.

units.source_text: 领内的田地，久已荒芜不堪。

en.t: The fields on the estate have long been so neglected that they are almost beyond recovery.

units.source_text: 我曾向已故的民部大辅请求，蒙他赏赐了我，但也送了他不少礼物。

en.t: I once petitioned the late Assistant Minister of Popular Affairs, and he granted them to me, though I also gave him many gifts.

units.source_text: 我便作为自己的产业耕作了。”

en.t: Since then I have cultivated them as my own property."

units.source_text: 他生怕田地里的产物被没收，所以那张毛发蓬松的脸变了相，鼻子红起来，嘴巴噘起来了。

en.t: Afraid that the produce from the fields might be confiscated, his shaggy face changed expression, his nose reddened, and his lips pushed out in a pout.

units.source_text: 明石道人连忙答道：“你可放心，那田地之事，我们一概不问，照旧由你管领就是了。

en.t: The Akashi monk hurriedly replied, "You may be at ease; we will not interfere at all with the matter of those fields, and you may manage them as before.

units.source_text: 那些地契房契还保存在我手中，只因我已谢绝世事，那里土地房产多年来不曾勘查过。

en.t: The land deeds and house documents are still kept in my possession, but since I withdrew from worldly affairs, the land and buildings there have not been inspected for many years.

units.source_text: 此事且待以后细细清理。”

en.t: We can leave this matter for careful sorting out later."

units.source_text: 这管家在话语中听出他家与源氏内大臣有缘，知道事情不易对付，此后便向明石道人领得了一大批修缮费，赶紧修理那邸宅了。

en.t: Hearing from his words that the Akashi family had ties with Lord Genji the Inner Minister, the steward realized the matter would not be easy to resist; afterward he received a large sum for repairs from the Akashi monk and hurriedly set about fixing the residence.
